faq.title: The key questions before your plan review

difference.question: What is the difference between surgery-only and full cover?
difference.answer: Surgery cover focuses on insured operations and, depending on the plan, diagnostics and aftercare. Full cover may also include outpatient treatment, medication and preventive care. The exact scope is always set by the policy terms.

preExisting.question: What happens with pre-existing conditions?
preExisting.answer: Medical information may lead to exclusions, additional premiums or rejection. The insurer decides whether and on what terms an animal can be accepted after its medical assessment.

age.question: Does my animal's age matter?
age.answer: Yes. Entry age, premium and available plans may depend on age. We therefore ask for it before making a recommendation and do not promise blanket acceptance.

horse.question: Why do horses have a separate path?
horse.answer: For horses, keeping and use matter alongside age and health. We therefore do not treat horse cover as a copied dog plan, but assess the need separately.

insurers.question: Which insurers does Healio compare?
insurers.answer: For dogs and cats we review Uelzener, Allianz, Helvetia and AGILA among others, for horses Uelzener, Allianz, BarmeniaGothaer, GHV and R+V. The selection depends on your animal's age, health and use. If an insurer is not an option, we tell you that too.

tracker.question: Does a GPS tracker come with the policy?
tracker.answer: With Uelzener, dog and cat owners can add a Tractive GPS and health tracker to a surgery or full-cover policy at no device cost. The tracker subscription costs extra, from about five euros a month on multi-year terms. The offer has no published end date, so we confirm it before you apply.

next.question: What happens after my inquiry?
next.answer: Healio reviews your information and responds personally with an assessment. Only then do you decide whether to submit a specific application. The inquiry itself is not a promise of cover.

providers.title: These are the insurers we review your cover with.
providers.subtitle: Healio is a broker. We compare through our broker pool and the insurers' own calculators, not through a comparison portal. Which plans qualify depends on species, age and health.

facts.one: Allianz: four lines Basis, Smart, Komfort and Premium, surgery limit 2,500 EUR to unlimited, entry from week 8 with no maximum age, three months waiting period, accidents immediately.
facts.two: Uelzener: reimbursement regardless of the GOT fee factor, annual limit 3,000, 6,000 EUR or unlimited, entry from day one with no maximum age, 30 days waiting period.
facts.three: Helvetia and AGILA: up to four times the GOT fee depending on the plan, age limits and deductible depend on the plan.

facts.one: Allianz: surgery limit 2,000 EUR to unlimited, treatment without surgery 1,000 to 6,000 EUR per line, no maximum age, three months waiting period.
facts.two: Uelzener: annual limit 1,000, 5,000 EUR or unlimited, outdoor and indoor cats insured alike, 30 days waiting period.
facts.three: We review dental care and FORL separately. Some plans apply longer waiting periods or separate add-ons for them.

facts.one: Uelzener and Allianz accept horses with no maximum entry age. BarmeniaGothaer up to 19 years, GHV up to 16, R+V up to 15, each for surgery cover.
facts.two: Allianz: surgery limit 7,500 EUR to unlimited. Uelzener: surgery or full cover with 15,000, 25,000 or 50,000 EUR per year, colic as a separate module.
facts.three: Colic, chips and X-ray findings, dental care, use and stays abroad are reviewed one by one before any recommendation.
